_status: T3 of docs/plans/2026-07-17-ast-chunking-all-languages.md. Every question is hand-verified against the real fixture source in evals/fixtures/ts_chunk_eval/ (read in full before writing the reference_answer, not generated). Gold files are DELIBERATELY 400-550+ real lines: an earlier draft used small (~80-250 line) target files and found BOTH chunkers hit 100% recall identically -- files that short never trigger the 512-token truncation this brick exists to fix, since window-300 either doesn't split them at all or the whole file already fits the embed budget. Questions target content positioned LATE in each file (past the point a 512-token embed window would reach), which is what actually exercises the difference. Scope: the languages a real React Native design partner's codebase actually uses.

questions.question: In TextField.tsx, what three accessibility props does GhostText set on its outer View to hide it from assistive tech?
In the Icon component in TextField.tsx, what color does the icon use when both ctx.isInvalid and ctx.focused are true?
questions.reference_answer: t.palette.negative_500, via the errorFocus style array.

questions.question: What does useTextFieldContext return in TextField.tsx?
questions.reference_answer: useContext(Context) -- the shared TextFieldContext value (inputRef, hover/focus state, isInvalid, etc.).

questions.question: What does applyRotateZ set on the matrix in MatrixMathHelper.kt, and with which trig functions?
What does MatrixDecompositionContext.reset() do in MatrixMathHelper.kt?
questions.reference_answer: It resets the perspective, scale, skew, translation, and rotationDegrees arrays to all zeros, via a private resetArray helper in its companion object.

questions.question: What does roundTo3Places do in MatrixMathHelper.kt?
questions.reference_answer: Rounds a Double to 3 decimal places: Math.round(n * 1000.0) * 0.001.

questions.question: What error does dismissModal raise in RNNCommandsHandler.mm if the target component is not a modal?
questions.reference_answer: It calls [RNNErrorHandler reject:...] with error code 1013 and the description "component with id: '<id>' is not a modal".

questions.question: What does dismissAllOverlays do in RNNCommandsHandler.mm?
questions.reference_answer: It calls assertReady and asserts the main queue, tells _overlayManager to dismissAllOverlays, then sends a navigation-command-completion event for dismissAllOverlays.

questions.question: Under what condition does assertReady raise a BridgeNotLoadedError in RNNCommandsHandler.mm?
questions.reference_answer: When RCT_NEW_ARCH_ENABLED is not defined AND self.readyToReceiveCommands is false -- i.e. on the old architecture, if a command is sent before Navigation.events().onAppLaunched() has fired.

questions.question: What does popTo do before calling pop in StackController.java?
questions.reference_answer: It walks the stack from the second-to-last entry toward the target viewController, removing and destroying every controller above it that isn't the target, then calls pop(mergeOptions, listener).

questions.question: In StackController.java, what does onDependentViewChanged do when the dependency is a Fab or FabMenu?
questions.reference_answer: It calls updateBottomMargin(dependency, getBottomInset()) on the found controller, via the perform() helper.

questions.question: What does the @RestrictTo(RestrictTo.Scope.TESTS) setView method do in StackController.java?
questions.reference_answer: It directly assigns the given StackLayout to the controller's protected `view` field -- a test-only setter.
